en.s: Caesar's civil war (49–45 BC) occurred during the late Roman Republic between two factions led by Julius Caesar and Pompey. The main cause of the war was political tensions relating to Caesar's place in the Republic on his expected return to Rome on the expiration of his governorship in Gaul. Before the war, Caesar had led an invasion of Gaul for almost ten years.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 恺撒内战发生于公元前49年至前45年，是罗马共和国晚期尤利乌斯·恺撒与庞培分别领导的两派之间的战争。主要起因是恺撒在高卢的总督任期即将届满、预期将返回罗马时，围绕他在共和国中的地位产生的政治紧张。此前，恺撒已率军在高卢征战近十年。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Wang Mang establishes the Xin dynasty
en.s: Wang Mang proclaimed himself emperor and established the Xin dynasty on 10 January AD 9, ending the Western Han period.

zh.s: 公元9年1月10日，王莽称帝，建立新朝，西汉时期结束。

en.t: Galba adopts Piso Licinianus as his heir
en.s: Roman emperor Galba adopted Lucius Calpurnius Piso Licinianus as his heir on 10 January AD 69. Otho, who had expected to be chosen instead, subsequently seized power; Galba and Piso were killed during that upheaval.

zh.t: 加尔巴收养皮索·利奇尼亚努斯并立其为继承人
zh.s: 公元69年1月10日，罗马皇帝加尔巴收养卢基乌斯·卡尔普尔尼乌斯·皮索·利奇尼亚努斯，并将他指定为继承人。原本期待自己获选的奥托随后夺取权力，加尔巴和皮索在这场政变中被杀。

en.t: Pope Fabian succeeds Anterus to become the twentieth pope of Rome
en.s: Pope Fabian (Latin: Fabianus) was the bishop of Rome and head of the Catholic Church from 10 January 236 until his death on 20 January 250, succeeding Anterus. A dove is said to have descended on his head to mark him as the Holy Spirit's unexpected choice to become the next pope. He was succeeded by Cornelius.

zh.t: 法比盎继任安德禄，成为第20任罗马教宗
zh.s: 法比盎（拉丁名 Fabianus）于236年1月10日继任安德禄，担任罗马主教和天主教会领袖，直至250年1月20日去世。相传一只鸽子落在他头上，被视为圣灵出人意料地选中他担任下一任教宗的标志。他的继任者是科尔乃略。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Oldcastle Revolt was a Lollard uprising directed against the Catholic Church and the English king, Henry V. The revolt was led by John Oldcastle, taking place on the night of 9/10 January 1414. The rebellion was crushed following a decisive battle on St. Giles's Fields.

zh.s: 1414年1月9日至10日夜间，约翰·奥尔德卡斯尔领导罗拉德派起义，反对天主教会及英格兰国王亨利五世。叛乱在圣吉尔斯原野的决定性战斗后被镇压。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Německý Brod (also Battle of Deutschbrod) took place on 10 January 1422, at Německý Brod in Bohemia, during the Hussite Wars. Led by Jan Žižka, the Hussites besieged the army of Royalist crusaders. The Roman Catholic crusaders were no match for the Hussites and Německý Brod was quickly taken and sacked. More than 500 mercenaries (548 according to the chronicles) drowned as they fled across the frozen Sázava River.

zh.s: 1422年1月10日，胡斯战争中的德意志布罗德战役在波希米亚展开。扬·杰士卡率领胡斯派围攻保王派十字军。天主教十字军无法抵挡，城镇很快被攻占并遭洗劫。500多名雇佣兵在逃过结冰的萨扎瓦河时溺亡，编年史记载的具体人数为548人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: Foundation of the Order of the Golden Fleece
en.s: Philip the Good, Duke of Burgundy, founded the Order of the Golden Fleece in Bruges on 10 January 1430, on the occasion of his marriage to Isabella of Portugal.

zh.s: 1430年1月10日，勃艮第公爵好人菲利普在布鲁日创立金羊毛骑士团，以庆祝自己与葡萄牙的伊莎贝拉成婚。

loc: 罗马尼亚西摩尔达维亚地区

en.s: The Battle of Vaslui (also referred to as the Battle of Podul Înalt or the Battle of Racova) was fought on January 10, 1475, between Stephen III of Moldavia and the Ottoman governor of Rumelia, Hadım Suleiman Pasha. The battle took place at Podul Înalt (the High Bridge), near the town of Vaslui, in Moldavia (now part of eastern Romania). The Ottoman troops numbered up to 120,000, facing about 40,000 Moldavian troops, plus smaller numbers of allied and mercenary troops. Stephen inflicted a decisive defeat on the Ottomans, described as "the greatest ever secured by the Cross against Islam," with casualties, according to Venetian and Polish records, reaching beyond 40,000 on the Ottoman side.

zh.s: 1475年1月10日，摩尔达维亚的斯特凡三世，与奥斯曼鲁米利亚总督哈迪姆·苏莱曼帕夏交战。战场位于摩尔达维亚瓦斯卢伊镇附近的波杜尔伊纳尔特，意为“高桥”，今属罗马尼亚东部，因此也称高桥战役或拉科瓦战役。奥斯曼军队多达12万人，面对约四万名摩尔达维亚士兵及人数较少的盟军和雇佣兵。斯特凡重创奥斯曼军队，此役曾被形容为“十字架对伊斯兰取得的最大胜利”。据威尼斯和波兰的记录，奥斯曼一方伤亡超过四万人。

en.s: The Raid of Panipat (1770) was a raid on 4 January 1770 by the Sikh forces led by Jassa Singh Ahluwalia against the Mughal forces led by Zabita Khan.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1770年1月4日，贾萨·辛格·阿卢瓦利亚率领锡克军队，对扎比塔·汗指挥的莫卧儿军队发动了帕尼帕特突袭。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: American Revolution: Thomas Paine publishes his pamphlet Common Sense
en.s: Thomas Paine (born Thomas Pain, February 9, 1737 [O.S. January 29, 1736] – June 8, 1809; ) was an English-born American Founding Father, inventor, political philosopher, and statesman. He authored Common Sense (1776) and The American Crisis (1776–1783), two of the most influential pamphlets at the start of the American Revolution, and he helped to inspire the colonial era patriots in 1776 to declare independence from Great Britain.

zh.t: 美国革命：托马斯·佩恩出版小册子《常识》
zh.s: 托马斯·佩恩出生名为 Thomas Pain，生于1737年2月9日（旧历1736年1月29日），卒于1809年6月8日，是英国出生的美国开国元勋、发明家、政治哲学家和政治家。他创作的《常识》（1776年）与《美国危机》（1776—1783年），是美国革命初期最具影响力的两部小册子，并在1776年帮助激励北美殖民地的爱国派宣布脱离英国独立。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The siege of Dunlap’s Station took place on January 10–11, 1791, during the Northwest Indian War. Native American forces of the Northwestern Confederacy attacked European American settlers in what is now southwestern Ohio. The siege was one of the Confederacy’s unsuccessful attacks during this period.

zh.s: 1791年1月10日至11日，西北印第安战争期间，原住民西北联盟部队围攻邓拉普驻地，袭击定居在今美国俄亥俄州西南部的欧洲裔移民。这是联盟在这一时期少数未能成功的进攻之一。

en.s: The 1833–34 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of a popular election (direct election) held on November 11, 1833, and a legislative vote held in January 1834. The task of electing the governor fell to the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the constitutionally required majority of the popular vote. National Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Jr. did not run for a tenth term in office.
en.n: This entry records the senate vote, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1833—1834年马萨诸塞州州长选举包括1833年11月11日举行的普选，以及1834年1月举行的州议会投票。由于没有候选人在普选中获得宪法规定的过半数选票，选举州长的任务交由马萨诸塞州议会完成。国家共和党籍州长小利瓦伊·林肯没有竞逐第十个任期。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的州参议院投票日期。

en.t: 1857 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1857 United States Senate election in California was held on January 10, 1857, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, former Democratic lieutenant governor David C. Broderick was elected over Know Nothing State Senator James W. Coffroth and Republican former congressman from North Carolina Edward Stanly.

zh.t: 1857年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1857年1月10日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第一组参议员席位的代表。两院特别联席会议选出民主党籍前副州长戴维·C.布罗德里克，击败一无所知党州参议员詹姆斯·W.科弗罗斯，以及共和党籍北卡罗来纳州前联邦众议员爱德华·斯坦利。

en.t: Florida adopts an ordinance of secession
en.s: Florida adopted an ordinance of secession on 10 January 1861, becoming the third state to declare its withdrawal from the United States.

zh.t: 佛罗里达州通过脱离联邦条例
zh.s: 1861年1月10日，佛罗里达州通过脱离联邦条例，成为第三个宣布退出美国的州。

loc: 美国肯塔基州弗洛伊德县

en.s: The Battle of Middle Creek was an engagement fought January 10, 1862, in Eastern Kentucky during the American Civil War. More than a month after Confederate Colonel John S. Williams left Kentucky, following the fight at Ivy Mountain, Brig. Gen. Humphrey Marshall led another force into Eastern Kentucky to continue recruiting activities. From his headquarters in Paintsville, on the Levisa Fork of the Big Sandy River, northwest of Prestonsburg, Marshall recruited volunteers. He raised a force of more than 2,000 men by early January, but could only partially equip them. Union Brig. Gen. Don Carlos Buell directed Col. James A.

zh.s: 1862年1月10日，美国内战中的米德尔溪战役在肯塔基州东部爆发。邦联上校约翰·S.威廉斯在艾维山战斗后离开肯塔基一个多月，汉弗里·马歇尔准将又率军进入该州东部，继续招募兵员。他以普雷斯顿斯堡西北、大桑迪河莱维萨支流上的佩恩茨维尔为总部招募志愿者。到1月初，部队超过2,000人，但只有部分人有装备。原文接着写到联邦军唐·卡洛斯·比尔准将向“詹姆斯·A.”上校下令处中断。

en.t: The Metropolitan Railway, the world's oldest underground railway, opens between Paddington and Farringdon, marking the beginning of the London Underground
en.s: The Metropolitan Railway (also known as the Met) was a passenger and goods railway that served London from 1863 to 1933, its main line heading north-west from the capital's financial heart in the City to what were to become the Middlesex suburbs. Its first line connected the main-line railway termini at Paddington, Euston, and King's Cross to the City.

zh.t: 世界最古老的地下铁路“大都会铁路”开通帕丁顿至法灵顿线路，伦敦地铁由此起步
zh.s: 大都会铁路又称 Met，是1863年至1933年间服务伦敦的客货运铁路。其主线从伦敦金融核心伦敦城向西北延伸，通往后来形成的米德尔塞克斯郊区。首条线路将帕丁顿、尤斯顿和国王十字等干线铁路终点站与伦敦城连接起来。

en.s: The Battle of Loudoun Heights was a small cavalry skirmish during the American Civil War between John Mosby's Rangers and Major Henry A. Cole's 1st Potomac Home Brigade Maryland Cavalry on January 10, 1864, in Loudoun County, Virginia. Cole's Cavalry successfully defended a night raid against their camp on Loudoun Heights. The fight was one of the first engagements in which Union forces held their own against Mosby's vaunted partisans.

zh.s: 1864年1月10日，美国内战中的劳登高地战役在弗吉尼亚州劳登县展开，是约翰·莫斯比游骑兵与亨利·A.科尔少校的马里兰波托马克乡土旅第一骑兵团之间的一场小规模骑兵战斗。科尔的骑兵成功守住劳登高地营地，击退夜袭。这是联邦军较早几次成功抵御莫斯比那支声名显赫的游击部队的战斗之一。

en.s: The 1864–65 New South Wales colonial election was held between 22 November 1864 and 10 January 1865. This election was for all of the 72 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 52 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1864年11月22日至1865年1月10日，新南威尔士殖民地举行选举，改选立法议会全部72个席位。选区包括52个单议席选区、6个双议席选区和2个四议席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.t: End of polling in the 1869–70 New South Wales election
en.s: Polling in the New South Wales colonial election ran from 3 December 1869 to 10 January 1870. All 72 seats in the Legislative Assembly were contested under first-past-the-post voting. This entry records the final polling day.

zh.t: 1869—1870年新南威尔士殖民地选举投票结束
zh.s: 新南威尔士殖民地选举的投票从1869年12月3日持续至1870年1月10日。立法议会全部72个席位均采用相对多数制选举产生。本条记录的是最后一个投票日。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 10 January 1874. The National Liberal Party remained the largest party in the Reichstag, with 155 of the 397 seats. Voter turnout was 61.2%.

en.t: The Plan of Tuxtepec is announced
en.s: In Mexican history, the Plan of Tuxtepec was a plan drafted by General Porfirio Díaz in 1876 and proclaimed on 10 January 1876 in the Villa de Ojitlán municipality of San Lucas Ojitlán, Tuxtepec district, Oaxaca. It was signed by a group of military officers led by Colonel Hermenegildo Sarmiento and drafted by porfiristas Vicente Riva Palacio, Ireneo Paz, and Protasio Tagle on the instigation of Díaz.

zh.s: 墨西哥历史上的《图斯特佩克计划》由波菲里奥·迪亚斯将军阵营于1876年制定，并于同年1月10日在瓦哈卡州图斯特佩克地区圣卢卡斯奥希特兰市镇的奥希特兰镇公布。计划由埃尔梅内希尔多·萨尔缅托上校率领的一群军官签署，具体由迪亚斯的支持者比森特·里瓦·帕拉西奥、伊雷内奥·帕斯和普罗塔西奥·塔格莱在其授意下起草。

en.s: A well at Spindletop near Beaumont, Texas, struck oil on 10 January 1901. The discovery produced a major gusher and helped launch the Texas oil boom.

zh.s: 1901年1月10日，美国得克萨斯州博蒙特附近的纺锤顶油田钻井打出石油，形成大规模井喷。这次发现推动了得克萨斯州石油热潮的兴起。

en.t: 1911 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1911 United States Senate election in California was held on January 10, 1911, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Republican Los Angeles City Councilman John D. Works was elected over fellow Republican and baseball executive Albert Spalding and several other minor candidates.

zh.t: 1911年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1911年1月10日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第一组参议员席位的代表。共和党籍洛杉矶市议员约翰·D.沃克斯，击败同党棒球管理人阿尔伯特·斯伯丁及数名支持较少的候选人，当选联邦参议员。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador in January 1911. Manuel Enrique Araujo was elected president through a popular election, receiving 182,964 votes. Araujo defeated General Luis Alonso Barahona and Doctor Esteban Castro. All men were eligible to vote in the election. President Fernando Figueroa selected Araujo as his successor and heavily rigged the election in his favor.

zh.s: 1911年1月，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举，曼努埃尔·恩里克·阿劳霍以182,964张选票当选。他击败了路易斯·阿隆索·巴拉奥纳将军和埃斯特班·卡斯特罗医生。当时所有男性均有投票资格。时任总统费尔南多·菲格罗亚选定阿劳霍接班，并大规模操纵选举，帮助他获胜。

en.s: The 1912 Georgia gubernatorial special election was held on January 10, 1912, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia for the remainder of Governor Hoke Smith's term, following his resignation on November 15, 1911, after having been elected to the United States Senate. Democratic nominee and former Governor of Georgia Joseph Mackey Brown defeated Socialist Party candidate A. F. Castleberry.

zh.s: 1912年1月10日，美国佐治亚州举行州长特别选举，以填补霍克·史密斯剩余任期内的职位空缺。史密斯当选美国参议员后，于1911年11月15日辞去州长职务。民主党候选人、前州长约瑟夫·麦基·布朗击败社会党候选人 A.F.卡斯尔伯里。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Adelaide on 10 January 1914. This was triggered by the death of Labor Party MP Ernest Roberts. The by-election was won by Labor Party candidate Edwin Yates. Single Tax League candidate Edward Craigie had previously contested the seat at the 1913 federal election as an independent candidate, achieving 4.6 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 1914年1月10日，澳大利亚联邦众议院阿德莱德选区举行补选，填补工党议员欧内斯特·罗伯茨去世后留下的席位。工党候选人埃德温·耶茨获胜。单一税联盟候选人爱德华·克雷吉，曾在1913年联邦选举中以独立身份角逐该席位，得票率为4.6%。

en.s: The Erzurum offensive (Russian: Эрзурумское сражение, romanized: Erzurumskoe srazhenie; Turkish: Erzurum Taarruzu) or Battle of Erzurum (Turkish: Erzurum Muharebesi) was a major winter offensive by the Imperial Russian Army on the Caucasus Campaign, during the First World War that led to the capture of the strategic city of Erzurum. The Turkish forces, in winter quarters, suffered a series of unexpected reverses, which led to a Russian victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃尔祖鲁姆攻势又称埃尔祖鲁姆战役，是第一次世界大战高加索战役期间，俄罗斯帝国陆军发动的一次重大冬季攻势，最终夺取战略要城埃尔祖鲁姆。驻冬营的土耳其军队接连遭遇意外失利，俄军取得胜利。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition (abbreviated as ITAE) of 1914–1917 is considered to be the last major expedition of the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration. Conceived by Sir Ernest Shackleton, the expedition was an attempt to make the first land crossing of the Antarctic continent. After Roald Amundsen's South Pole expedition in 1911, this crossing remained, in Shackleton's words, the "one great main object of Antarctic journeyings".
en.n: Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition: Seven survivors of the Ross Sea party are rescued after being stranded for several months.

zh.s: 1914年至1917年的帝国横越南极远征（ITAE）被认为是南极探险英雄时代最后一次重大远征。远征由欧内斯特·沙克尔顿爵士构想，试图首次从陆路横穿南极大陆。罗尔德·阿蒙森于1911年抵达南极点后，在沙克尔顿看来，横穿南极大陆就成了南极旅程中“唯一剩下的重大目标”。
zh.n: 帝国横越南极远征：罗斯海支队的七名幸存者在被困数月后获救。

en.s: U.S. troops fought Cossacks at Posolskaya station in Siberia on 10 January 1920, as the American expedition was preparing to withdraw from Russia.

zh.t: 波索尔斯卡亚车站交战
zh.s: 1920年1月10日，美军在西伯利亚的波索尔斯卡亚车站与哥萨克武装交战。当时，美国远征军正准备撤出俄国。

en.t: Treaty of Versailles enters into force
en.s: The Treaty of Versailles entered into force on 10 January 1920. Signed on 28 June 1919, it established the peace settlement between Germany and most of the Allied Powers after the First World War.

zh.s: 1920年1月10日，《凡尔赛条约》生效。这份条约于1919年6月28日签署，确立了第一次世界大战后德国与大多数协约国之间的和平安排。

en.t: Establishment of the League of Nations
en.s: The League of Nations was established on 10 January 1920. Its principal mission was to maintain world peace, using collective security, disarmament and the peaceful settlement of international disputes.

zh.s: 1920年1月10日，国际联盟成立。它以维护世界和平为主要使命，主张通过集体安全、裁军及和平解决国际争端来实现这一目标。

en.t: Covenant of the League of Nations
en.s: The Covenant of the League of Nations was the charter of the League of Nations. It was signed on 28 June 1919 as Part I of the Treaty of Versailles, and became effective together with the rest of the Treaty on 10 January 1920.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《国际联盟盟约》是国际联盟的创设文件。盟约于1919年6月28日作为《凡尔赛条约》的第一部分签署，并与条约其余部分一同于1920年1月10日生效。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的生效日期。

en.s: There was no All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final in 1925. The 1925 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship ended in chaos, with first Mayo, and then Galway being proclaimed champions after Kerry and Cavan were disqualified. Instead, a new inter-provincial tournament was organised by the GAA Central Council, of which the final was played between Galway and Cavan on 10 January 1926.

zh.t: 1925年全爱尔兰高级盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1925年实际上并未举行全爱尔兰高级盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛。该届赛事在混乱中结束：凯里与卡文被取消资格后，梅奥和戈尔韦先后被宣布为冠军。盖尔运动协会中央理事会随后改办了一项新的省际赛事，由戈尔韦与卡文于1926年1月10日进行决赛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Fritz Lang’s silent science-fiction film Metropolis had its world premiere at the UFA-Palast am Zoo in Berlin on 10 January 1927. The screenplay was written by Thea von Harbou in collaboration with Lang.

zh.t: 电影《大都会》举行全球首映
zh.s: 1927年1月10日，弗里茨·朗执导的科幻默片《大都会》在德国柏林的乌法动物园宫影院举行全球首映。影片剧本由特娅·冯·哈布与朗共同创作。

en.s: General elections were held in Cuba on 10 January 1936. Miguel Mariano Gómez of the Tripartate Coalition (an alliance of the Liberal Party, the Nationalist Union and Republican Action) won the presidential election, whilst the Coalition also emerged as the largest party in the House of Representatives. Voter turnout was 67.1%.

zh.s: 1936年1月10日，古巴举行大选。由自由党、民族主义联盟和共和行动组成的三党联盟，其候选人米格尔·马里亚诺·戈麦斯赢得总统选举，联盟同时在众议院成为最大政治力量。投票率为67.1%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Northwest Airlines Flight 2 was a Lockheed Super Electra aircraft, registration NC17388, which crashed into the Bridger Mountains in Gallatin County, Montana, about twelve miles (20 km) northeast of Bozeman, on January 10, 1938. All ten people on board were killed in the accident, which was the first fatal crash of a Lockheed Super Electra and of a Northwest Airlines aircraft.

zh.s: 1938年1月10日，西北航空2号班机在美国蒙大拿州加拉廷县的布里杰山脉坠毁，地点位于博兹曼东北约12英里（20公里）处。失事飞机为一架注册编号NC17388的洛克希德“超级伊莱克特拉”客机，机上10人全部遇难。这是该机型和西北航空首次发生致命空难。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; Chinese Events calendar and English linked-topic occurrence evidence

en.s: Greek troops captured Klisura Pass in Albania on 10 January 1941 during the Greco-Italian War. The capture followed several days of fighting; the wider battle continued beyond that day.

zh.t: 希腊军队攻占克利苏拉山口
zh.s: 1941年1月10日，希腊军队在希意战争中攻占了位于阿尔巴尼亚的克利苏拉山口。此前双方已交战数日，围绕山口展开的整场战斗在攻占当天之后仍在继续。

en.t: Opening of the first United Nations General Assembly session
en.s: The first session of the United Nations General Assembly opened at Methodist Central Hall in London on 10 January 1946. Representatives of the 51 founding nations attended.

zh.t: 联合国大会第一届会议开幕
zh.s: 1946年1月10日，联合国大会第一届会议在英国伦敦卫理公会中央礼堂开幕，51个创始成员国的代表出席会议。

en.s: The Huaihai campaign (Chinese: 淮海戰役; pinyin: Huáihǎi Zhànyì), or Battle of Hsupeng (traditional Chinese: 徐蚌會戰; simplified Chinese: 徐蚌会战; pinyin: Xúbèng Huìzhàn), was one of the military conflicts in the late stage of the Chinese Civil War between the Kuomintang and the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). The campaign started when the People's Liberation Army (PLA) launched a major offensive against the Kuomintang headquarters in Xuzhou on 6 November 1948, and ended on 10 January 1949 when the PLA reached the north of the Yangtze.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 淮海战役又称徐蚌会战，是国共内战后期国民党与中国共产党之间的一场军事战役。1948年11月6日，中国人民解放军向国民党军位于徐州的指挥中枢发动大规模攻势，战役由此开始；至1949年1月10日，解放军推进至长江以北地区，战役结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On Sunday 10 January 1954, British Overseas Airways Corporation Flight 781, a de Havilland DH.106 Comet 1, registered G-ALYP, took off from Ciampino Airport in Rome, Italy, en route to Heathrow Airport in London, England, on the final leg of its flight from Singapore. At about 10:51 GMT, the aircraft suffered an explosive decompression at altitude and crashed into the Mediterranean Sea, killing everyone on board.

zh.t: 英国海外航空781号班机空难
zh.s: 1954年1月10日星期日，英国海外航空781号班机从意大利罗马钱皮诺机场起飞，前往英国伦敦希思罗机场，执行从新加坡出发的航程最后一段。执飞飞机为德哈维兰DH.106“彗星”1型，注册编号G-ALYP。格林尼治时间约10时51分，飞机在高空发生爆炸性失压，坠入地中海，机上人员全部遇难。

en.s: The first elections to the Nagaland Legislative Assembly were held in January 1964 to elect members of the 40 constituencies in Nagaland, India. There were no political parties registered and so all the candidates fought as Independents. P. Shilu Ao was appointed as the first Chief Minister of Nagaland. Nagaland was converted to a state by the State of Nagaland Act, 1962 and elections were called for in 1964.

zh.s: 印度那加兰邦于1964年1月举行首次立法议会选举，选出40个选区的议员。当时没有注册政党，所有候选人均以独立身份参选。P.希卢·奥获任该邦首任首席部长。那加兰依据《1962年那加兰邦法》建邦，随后安排于1964年举行选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Tashkent Declaration was signed between India and Pakistan on 10 January 1966 to resolve the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965. Peace was achieved on 23 September through interventions by the Soviet Union and the United States, both of which pushed the two warring countries towards a ceasefire in an attempt to avoid any escalation that could draw in other powers.

zh.s: 1966年1月10日，印度与巴基斯坦签署《塔什干宣言》，以解决1965年印巴战争的遗留问题。此前，双方在苏联和美国的推动下，于9月23日实现停火。美苏都试图避免冲突升级，以免将其他大国卷入。

en.t: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman returns to Bangladesh
en.s: After his release from prison in Pakistan, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman returned to Dhaka, Bangladesh, on 10 January 1972. His return followed the country’s war of independence and was greeted by large crowds at Tejgaon Airport.

zh.t: 谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼返回孟加拉国
zh.s: 1972年1月10日，谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼获释离开巴基斯坦监狱后，返回孟加拉国首都达卡。孟加拉国此前刚经历独立战争，大批民众在特杰冈机场迎接他归来。

en.t: Opening of the first World Hindi Conference
en.s: The first World Hindi Conference opened in Nagpur, India, on 10 January 1975. Indian prime minister Indira Gandhi inaugurated the conference, which continued until 12 January.

zh.t: 首届世界印地语大会开幕
zh.s: 1975年1月10日，首届世界印地语大会在印度那格浦尔开幕，由印度总理英迪拉·甘地主持开幕式。大会持续至1月12日。

en.t: Opening of Ocean Park Hong Kong
en.s: Ocean Park Hong Kong, commonly known simply as Ocean Park, is an animal theme park in Hong Kong. Covering an area of 91.5 hectares (226 acres) in Wong Chuk Hang, it is the largest theme park by area in Hong Kong, and is also the city's second-oldest theme park, after the now-defunct Lai Chi Kok Amusement Park.

zh.s: 香港海洋公园通常简称海洋公园，是位于香港黄竹坑的动物主题公园，占地91.5公顷（226英亩）。按面积计算，它是香港最大的主题公园；按创办时间计算，它也是香港历史第二悠久的主题公园，仅次于现已关闭的荔园。

en.t: Publication of Addiction Rare in Patients Treated with Narcotics
en.s: A five-sentence letter by Jane Porter and Hershel Jick appeared in The New England Journal of Medicine on 10 January 1980. It reported observations about addiction among hospital patients given narcotics and was later cited outside that limited context.

zh.t: 《接受麻醉性药物治疗的患者很少成瘾》发表
zh.s: 1980年1月10日，简·波特与赫谢尔·吉克合著的一封五句话的读者来信刊于《新英格兰医学杂志》。文章报告了接受麻醉性药物治疗的住院患者的成瘾观察结果，后来却被引用到超出这一特定情境的论述中。

en.t: Start of the FMLN’s January 1981 offensive
en.s: The Farabundo Martí National Liberation Front launched a major offensive in El Salvador on 10 January 1981. It sought to overthrow the ruling Revolutionary Government Junta. The offensive continued until 26 January and ended in a military defeat for the FMLN.

zh.t: 法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线发动1981年1月攻势
zh.s: 1981年1月10日，法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线在萨尔瓦多发动大规模攻势，试图推翻执政的革命政府委员会。攻势持续至1月26日，最终以该组织的军事失败告终。

en.t: United States and Holy See establish diplomatic relations
en.s: The United States and the Holy See announced the establishment of full diplomatic relations on 10 January 1984. The announcement preceded the appointment and confirmation of their diplomatic representatives.

zh.t: 美国与圣座宣布建立全面外交关系
zh.s: 1984年1月10日，美国与圣座宣布建立全面外交关系。双方外交代表的任命与确认程序在此后进行。

en.s: The Battle of Birembo (10 January 1985) was fought between National Resistance Movement (NRM) rebels and the Ugandan government, supported by North Korean forces, during the late Ugandan Bush War. In the clash, the government forces were almost able to encircle a strong insurgent force which included the NRM chief commander, Yoweri Museveni, but ultimately could not prevent a successful rebel breakout.

zh.s: 1985年1月10日，乌干达丛林战争后期，全国抵抗运动叛军与得到朝鲜部队支援的乌干达政府军，在比伦博交战。政府军几乎包围了一支实力较强的叛军部队，其中包括全国抵抗运动总指挥约韦里·穆塞韦尼，但最终未能阻止叛军成功突围。

en.t: Daniel Ortega takes office as president of Nicaragua
en.s: Daniel Ortega took office as president of Nicaragua on 10 January 1985. He had previously served as coordinator of the Junta of National Reconstruction from 1979 to 1985.

zh.t: 丹尼尔·奥尔特加就任尼加拉瓜总统
zh.s: 1985年1月10日，丹尼尔·奥尔特加就任尼加拉瓜总统。此前，他于1979年至1985年担任民族复兴委员会协调员。

en.s: The 1992 Albanian Supercup was the fourth edition of the Albanian Supercup since its establishment in 1989. The match was contested between the Albanian Cup 1992 winners KS Elbasani and the 1991–92 Albanian Superliga champions KS Vllaznia. KS Elbasani won 3-2 in extra time.

zh.s: 1992年阿尔巴尼亚超级杯是这项赛事自1989年创办以来的第四届比赛，由1992年阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军埃尔巴萨尼队对阵1991—1992赛季阿尔巴尼亚超级联赛冠军维拉斯尼亚队。埃尔巴萨尼队在加时赛后以3比2获胜。

en.t: Shek Kip Mei HSBC arson attack
en.s: An arson attack at an HSBC branch in Shek Kip Mei, Hong Kong, caused a fatal fire.

zh.t: 石硖尾汇丰银行纵火案
zh.s: 香港石硖尾一家汇丰银行分行遭纵火，火灾造成人员死亡。

en.t: Establishment of the National Climate Center
en.s: China established the National Climate Center in Beijing. The center became part of the China Meteorological Administration.

zh.s: 中国在北京成立国家气候中心，该中心后来成为中国气象局的组成机构。

en.s: House Party - the third House Party professional wrestling supercard event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) - took place on January 10, 1998 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. Excerpts from House Party aired on episodes #247 and #248 of the syndicated television show ECW Hardcore TV on January 14 and 21, 1998, while the full event was later released on VHS and DVD.

zh.s: 1998年1月10日，极限冠军摔角联盟（ECW）在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场，举办第三届“家庭派对”大型职业摔角赛事，安排多场重点比赛。片段分别于1月14日和21日，在联合播出的《ECW Hardcore TV》第247及248期播出，完整赛事后来发行VHS录像带和DVD。

en.s: The Hopman Cup X (also known as the Hyundai Hopman Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the tenth edition of the Hopman Cup tournament between nations in men's and women's tennis. The tournament commenced on 4 January 1998 at the Burswood Entertainment Complex in Burswood, Western Australia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第十届霍普曼杯因赞助关系也称现代汽车霍普曼杯，是由各国男女网球选手共同参赛的国家队赛事。比赛于1998年1月4日在澳大利亚西澳大利亚州伯斯伍德的伯斯伍德娱乐中心开赛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Guilty as Charged (1999) was the inaugural ECW Guilty as Charged professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). The event took place on January 10, 1999 at the Millennium Theatre in Kissimmee, Florida. The main event was a singles match between champion Shane Douglas and challenger Taz for the ECW World Heavyweight Championship. Taz won the title, ending Douglas' 406 day reign, the longest in the title's history.

zh.s: 1999年1月10日，极限冠军摔角联盟（ECW）在美国佛罗里达州基西米的千禧剧院，举办首届“罪名成立”按次付费职业摔角赛。压轴赛由冠军谢恩·道格拉斯与挑战者塔兹，争夺ECW世界重量级冠军。塔兹获胜，终结道格拉斯长达406天的冠军任期，这也是该头衔历史上最长的连续持有纪录。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Kazakhstan held a presidential election on 10 January 1999. Incumbent Nursultan Nazarbayev won more than 80% of the vote. Reported voter turnout was 87%.

zh.s: 1999年1月10日，哈萨克斯坦举行总统选举，时任总统努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫以超过80%的选票获胜。据公布的数据，投票率为87%。

en.s: Crossair Flight 498 was a scheduled commuter flight from Zurich, Switzerland, to Dresden, Germany. On 10 January 2000, the Saab 340B operating the flight crashed two minutes after takeoff in the Swiss municipality of Niederhasli, killing all 10 passengers and crew. The accident was investigated by the Swiss Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB), and a final report was issued in 2004.

zh.s: 十字航空498号班机是从瑞士苏黎世飞往德国德累斯顿的定期支线航班。2000年1月10日，执飞的萨博340B客机在起飞两分钟后，于瑞士下哈斯利市镇坠毁，机上十名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。瑞士航空事故调查局负责调查，并于2004年发布最终报告。

en.s: The 2003 Djiboutian parliamentary election took place in Djibouti on 10 January 2003 to elect the National Assembly of Djibouti. The ruling coalition of President Ismail Omar Guelleh won all 65 seats in the election defeating an opposition coalition.

zh.s: 2003年1月10日，吉布提举行国民议会选举。总统伊斯梅尔·奥马尔·盖莱领导的执政联盟击败反对派联盟，赢得全部65个席位。

en.s: The 2002–03 Durand Cup final was the 115th final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giant East Bengal and Army XI on 10 January 2003 at the Ambedkar Stadium in Delhi. East Bengal won the final 3–0 to claim their 15th Durand Cup title. Mike Okoro, Kalia Kulothungan and Douglas Silva scored three goals in the second half as East Bengal won the title.

zh.s: 2003年1月10日，第115届杜兰德杯决赛在印度德里安贝德卡尔体育场举行，由加尔各答劲旅东孟加拉对阵陆军十一人队。杜兰德杯是印度历史最悠久的足球赛事。迈克·奥科罗、卡利亚·库洛通甘及道格拉斯·席尔瓦在下半场各进一球，帮助东孟加拉以3比0获胜，第15次夺冠。

en.t: North Korea announces withdrawal from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty
en.s: On 10 January 2003, North Korea announced that it was withdrawing from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons. This entry records the announcement; the legal status and effective date of withdrawal require a separate distinction.

zh.t: 朝鲜宣布退出《不扩散核武器条约》
zh.s: 2003年1月10日，朝鲜宣布退出《不扩散核武器条约》。本条记录的是退出声明；退出在法律上的地位及生效日期，需要与声明日期分别看待。

en.s: The 2007 Guinean general strike began on January 10, 2007. Guinea's trade unions and opposition parties called on President Lansana Conté to resign, accusing him of mismanaging the economy and abusing his authority. The strikers also accused Conté of personally securing the release of Mamadou Sylla and Fode Soumah, both accused of corruption, from prison. The strike ended on January 27 with an agreement between Conté and the unions, according to which Conté would appoint a new prime minister; however, Conté's choice of Eugène Camara as prime minister was deemed unacceptable by the unions, and the strike resumed on February 12.

zh.s: 2007年1月10日，几内亚开始全国总罢工。工会和反对党要求总统兰萨纳·孔戴辞职，指控他治理经济不善、滥用职权。罢工者还指责孔戴亲自干预，使被控腐败的马马杜·西拉和福德·苏马获释。1月27日，孔戴与工会达成协议，承诺任命一名新总理，罢工结束。但工会无法接受他选择的欧仁·卡马拉，于2月12日恢复罢工。

en.t: Bush announces a troop increase in Iraq
en.s: In a televised address on 10 January 2007, U.S. president George W. Bush announced a new Iraq strategy that included sending more than 20,000 additional American troops. The announcement was made from the White House Library.

zh.t: 布什宣布向伊拉克增兵
zh.s: 2007年1月10日，美国总统乔治·W·布什发表电视讲话，宣布新的伊拉克战略，其中包括增派超过2万名美军。讲话在白宫图书室发表。

en.s: The 2008 Guerra del Golfo (Spanish for "Gulf War") was a major professional wrestling event produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group ("IWRG"; sometimes referred to as Grupo Internacional Revolución in Mexico) on January 10, 2008. The 2008 version of the IWRG Guerra del Golfo was the second time overall IWRG used the name, and the beginning of it becoming an annual IWRG show. The annual Guerra del Golfo main event consists of three matches in total, with two "qualifying matches", multi-man steel cage matches where the last person left in the cage advances to the main event of the night.

zh.s: 2008年1月10日，墨西哥国际摔角革命集团（IWRG）策划并举办大型职业摔角赛事“海湾战争”。该组织在墨西哥有时也称Grupo Internacional Revolución。这是IWRG第二次使用这一赛事名称，也从此开始将其办成年度赛事。压轴部分共包含三场比赛：前两场为多人钢笼资格赛，每场最后留在笼中的选手进入当晚的最终主赛。

en.s: The January 2010 Battle of Beledweyne began on January 10, 2010 when Ahlu Sunna Waljama'a forces attacked and captured East Beledweyne which was being held by the Hizbul Islam insurgent group. It was initially reported that TFG forces took part in the offensive however Ahlu Sunna Waljma'a leaders said the government was not helping them during the offensive. Fighting soon spread from the East to the center of the city. It became the first battle in months were al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam groups cooperated against the TFG.

zh.s: 2010年1月10日，逊尼派民兵组织“圣训与公理会”进攻并夺取由伊斯兰党叛军控制的贝莱德文东部，战役由此开始。最初有报道称，过渡联邦政府军参与了攻势，但“圣训与公理会”领导人表示，政府没有为行动提供帮助。战斗很快从东部蔓延至市中心。这也是青年党与伊斯兰党数月来首次合作对抗过渡联邦政府的战斗。

en.s: WEC 46: Varner vs. Henderson was a mixed martial arts event held by World Extreme Cagefighting on January 10, 2010. It took place at the ARCO Arena in Sacramento, California.

zh.s: 2010年1月10日，世界极限笼斗组织举办综合格斗赛事 WEC 46“瓦尔纳对亨德森”。比赛在美国加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托的 ARCO 体育馆举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia on 27 December 2009 and 10 January 2010. Twelve candidates participated in the first round, prior to a run-off between first-round winner Ivo Josipović and runner-up Milan Bandić. In the run-off, Josipović won a landslide victory, receiving 60.3% of the vote becoming the first elected president nominated by the Social Democratic Party of Croatia (SDP).
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克罗地亚总统选举分别于2009年12月27日和2010年1月10日举行。首轮共有12名候选人参选，得票前两位的伊沃·约西波维奇和米兰·班迪奇随后进入第二轮投票。约西波维奇在第二轮以60.3%的选票大胜，成为首位由克罗地亚社会民主党提名并当选的总统。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2012 Khyber Agency bombing occurred on 10 January 2012, when a bomb exploded near a petrol pump in the town of Jamrud near the Afghan border in Khyber Agency of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA) of Pakistan. The bombing killed at least 30 people while 78 others were injured.

zh.t: 2012年巴基斯坦开伯尔特区爆炸
zh.s: 2012年1月10日，巴基斯坦联邦直辖部落地区开伯尔特区、靠近阿富汗边境的贾姆鲁德镇，一处加油站附近发生炸弹爆炸，造成至少30人死亡、78人受伤。

en.s: The 2012 New Hampshire Republican presidential primary took place on Tuesday, January 10, 2012. Former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney won the primary.

zh.t: 2012年美国共和党新罕布什尔州总统初选
zh.s: 2012年1月10日星期二，美国共和党在新罕布什尔州举行总统初选，前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼获胜。

en.s: The 2012 New Hampshire Democratic presidential primary took place on Tuesday, January 10, 2012, as the second major contest of the primary cycle following the Iowa caucuses the previous week. New Hampshire's 28 pledged delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated based on the results of the primary. Incumbent President Barack Obama won the primary in a landslide facing no major opposition to his candidacy.

zh.t: 2012年美国民主党新罕布什尔州总统初选
zh.s: 2012年1月10日星期二，民主党在新罕布什尔州举行总统初选，是前一周艾奥瓦党团会议之后，本轮提名程序的第二场主要角逐。该州参加民主党全国代表大会的28名承诺代表，按初选结果分配。现任总统贝拉克·奥巴马没有遇到主要对手，以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: Bombings struck Quetta and Swat in Pakistan on 10 January 2013. The attacks in Quetta prompted protests by members of the city’s Shia Hazara community.

zh.t: 奎达与斯瓦特发生爆炸袭击
zh.s: 2013年1月10日，巴基斯坦奎达和斯瓦特发生爆炸袭击。奎达的袭击引发了当地什叶派哈扎拉族居民的抗议。

en.s: The 2015–16 New Democracy leadership election refers to the two-round election to determine the next president of New Democracy, after the resignation of Antonis Samaras on 5 July 2015. The first round was held on 20 December 2015 and the second round was held on 10 January 2016. Kyriakos Mitsotakis was elected as the new president.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2015年7月5日，安东尼斯·萨马拉斯辞去希腊新民主党主席职务，党内随后举行两轮选举，选出新任主席。首轮投票于2015年12月20日举行，第二轮于2016年1月10日举行，最终基里亚科斯·米佐塔基斯当选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: National Front for Liberation–Tahrir al-Sham conflict
en.s: The National Front for Liberation–Tahrir al-Sham conflict began on 1 January 2019 during clashes between Nour al-Din al-Zenki Movement and Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), after HTS launched an attack against the group in Darat Izza, Taqad, and Khan al-Asal fronts in rebel-held western Aleppo. The conflict ended on 10 January 2019, after the National Front for Liberation agreed to withdraw, allowing HTS to take over almost all of the remaining opposition-held areas of the Idlib pocket.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 民族解放阵线与沙姆解放组织冲突
zh.s: 2019年1月1日，沙姆解放组织向努尔丁·赞基运动发动进攻，双方在阿勒颇西部由反对派控制的达拉特伊扎、塔卡德和汗阿萨勒一带交战，民族解放阵线与沙姆解放组织之间的冲突由此开始。1月10日，民族解放阵线同意撤离，冲突结束，沙姆解放组织得以接管伊德利卜反对派控制区几乎所有剩余地区。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: A 13-year-old American girl, Jayme Closs, is found alive in Gordon, Wisconsin, having been kidnapped 88 days earlier from her parents' home whilst they were murdered
en.s: On October 15, 2018, 21-year-old Jake Thomas Patterson abducted 13-year-old Jayme Lynn Closs after fatally shooting her parents, James and Denise Closs, at their home just outside of Barron, Wisconsin, at 12:53 a.m. Patterson took Closs to a house 70 miles (110 km) away in rural Gordon, Wisconsin, and held her in captivity for 88 days until she escaped on January 10, 2019, seeking help from neighbors.

zh.t: 杰米·克洛斯逃离囚禁并向邻居求助
zh.s: 2018年10月15日凌晨，杰克·帕特森在威斯康星州巴伦附近杀害杰米·克洛斯的父母，并将当时13岁的她绑架。她被囚禁在戈登附近88天后，于2019年1月10日逃出并向邻居求助。

en.s: Bash at the Brewery 2 was a professional wrestling event produced by Impact Wrestling in conjunction with River City Wrestling. It took place on January 10, 2020 at the Freetail Brewing Company in San Antonio, Texas and aired exclusively Impact Plus. Nine professional wrestling matches were contested at the event.

zh.t: 第二届“啤酒厂激战”摔角赛
zh.s: 2020年1月10日，Impact Wrestling与River City Wrestling联合在美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的Freetail酿酒公司，举办职业摔角赛事“啤酒厂激战2”，仅通过Impact Plus播出。赛事共进行九场比赛。

en.s: ONE Championship: A New Tomorrow was held at IMPACT Arena in Thailand on 10 January 2020. The event featured a rematch between Rodtang Jitmuangnon and Jonathan Haggerty for the ONE flyweight Muay Thai world championship.

zh.s: 2020年1月10日，ONE冠军赛“崭新明天”在泰国IMPACT体育馆举行。赛事安排了罗唐·吉特蒙农与乔纳森·哈格蒂的二番战，争夺ONE蝇量级泰拳世界冠军。

en.s: Elections to the Almaty City Mäslihat were held on 10 January 2021 to elect 39 deputies of the Almaty City Mäslihat. This was the first time that all city deputies were elected under party-list proportional representation. The Nur Otan won majority of 29 seats in the Almaty City Mäslihat followed by the other 3 parties.

zh.s: 2021年1月10日，阿拉木图举行市议会选举，选出39名议员。这是该市首次全部通过政党名单比例代表制选出议员。“祖国之光”党获得29席，占据多数，其余席位由另外三个政党取得。

en.s: Local elections were held in Kazakhstan on 10 January 2021 to elect in total of all 3,246 members of the 214 mäslihats (local assemblies) which included 489 regional members and 2,757 municipal members. This is the first election to take place under party-list proportional representation system that was enacted in 2018, giving political parties a role in local races and it coincided with the 2021 legislative elections.

zh.s: 2021年1月10日，哈萨克斯坦举行地方选举，选出214个地方议会的全部3,246名议员，其中包括489名地区级议员和2,757名市镇级议员。这是2018年确立政党名单比例代表制后首次按该制度举行的地方选举，政党由此参与地方竞选。选举与2021年议会选举同时举行。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Kazakhstan on 10 January 2021 to elect the members of the Mäjilis to the 7th Parliament of Kazakhstan. They were the eighth legislative elections in Kazakhstan's history since independence and coincided with the 2021 local elections. The elections were the first to be held under Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's presidency and the first since 2004 to be held at the normally scheduled date, rather than due to an early dissolution of the Mäjilis.

zh.s: 2021年1月10日，哈萨克斯坦举行议会选举，选出第七届议会下院马吉利斯的议员。这是该国独立以来的第八次议会选举，与2021年地方选举同时举行。它既是卡瑟姆若马尔特·托卡耶夫任总统以来的首次议会选举，也是2004年以来首次按正常时间举行、而非因提前解散马吉利斯而举行的选举。

en.t: 2022 President of the Hong Kong Legislative Council election
en.s: The election for the President of the Seventh Legislative Council took place on 10 January 2022 for members of the 7th Legislative Council of Hong Kong to among themselves elect the President of the Legislative Council of Hong Kong for the duration of the council.

zh.s: 2022年1月10日，香港第七届立法会举行主席选举，由本届议员从彼此之中选出主席，任期与本届立法会相同。

en.s: On January 10, 2023, voters in the 7th district of the Virginia Senate voted in a special election to fill the seat left vacant by Republican Jen Kiggans, the previous incumbent, who had resigned on January 3, 2023, after having been elected to Congress the preceding November. New state legislative maps took effect on January 11, 2023, at the start of 2023 legislative.

zh.t: 2023年美国弗吉尼亚州参议院第七选区特别选举
zh.s: 2023年1月10日，弗吉尼亚州参议院第七选区举行特别选举，填补共和党人珍·基根斯留下的席位。基根斯在前一年11月当选联邦众议员后，于2023年1月3日辞去州参议员职务。新州议会选区划分于1月11日生效；原文在说明2023年立法会期开始处中断。

en.s: On January 10, 2023, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) attacked Malian soldiers and Wagner Group mercenaries in the villages of Diafarabé and Koumara in central Mali.

zh.t: 马里迪亚法拉贝与库马拉遇袭
zh.s: 2023年1月10日，支持伊斯兰与穆斯林组织的圣战武装，在马里中部迪亚法拉贝和库马拉两村，袭击马里士兵及瓦格纳集团雇佣兵。

en.t: ONE Friday Fights 93: Kongchai vs. Ondash
en.s: ONE Friday Fights 93: Kongchai vs. Ondash took place at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand, on 10 January 2025. A strawweight Muay Thai bout between Kongchai Chanaidonmuang and Ramadan Ondash headlined the event.

zh.t: ONE周五格斗夜93：贡猜对阵翁达什
zh.s: 2025年1月10日，ONE周五格斗夜93在泰国曼谷伦披尼拳场举行，头条主赛是贡猜·查奈顿芒与拉马丹·翁达什之间的草量级泰拳比赛。
